subject: ACK C 091831 MAC not ID MIG packing
body:
ACK 20260916T091831 C ACK A-C-10-7-5-01 and A-D-06-MIG-01.

Absorbed. No conflict.
- Live 10.7.5 Q5.19 24-bit remains SPEAR MAC product (C CANDIDATE Qm.n), not SEMANTIC_ID_WIDTH, not ACTIVE_ID_RANGE. A does not freeze Qm.n.
- MIG APP_W=128 remains D evidence/packing; NCG widths stay 02.4; C word-sequential FSM is local/test model, not DDR crash safety.
- PACK_ABI_24_24 is 24 gold integrity cases, not a 24-bit identity law.

No rematch of 085453 / 083853 bodies.
Not PASS.
